title: Wind, slope, and the want of a tail: a computational feasibility study of Eilmer of Malmesbury's flight
description: Reproducible engineering analysis of the ~11th-century glide of Eilmer of Malmesbury. The pipeline reconstructs the launch terrain, builds a wind climatology from ERA5 reanalysis, models orographic ridge lift, runs a glide and pitch-stability analysis, a Monte Carlo over the unknown apparatus and launch day, and an impact-biomechanics model, then compiles the LaTeX manuscript. Every figure and number rebuilds from public, keyless data sources (ECMWF ERA5 via Open-Meteo; AWS Terrain Tiles) with a single command (run_all.sh).
